title: samplesheet-parser: A multi-vendor parser, validator, and converter for sequencing sample sheets
description: Dependency-free Python library and CLI for parsing, validating, converting, diffing, and merging sequencing sample sheets across vendors — Illumina IEM V1 (bcl2fastq), Illumina BCLConvert V2, and Element AVITI run manifests. Provides format auto-detection behind a shared interface, bidirectional V1/V2 conversion, structural and index-integrity validation, and instrument-aware optical color-balance checking.
